subject: Request: temporary grace period for ephemeral logs during incident review
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@crestfield.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-06-30T08:22:00Z
Subject: Request: temporary retention grace for Crestfield tenant logs

Hi Rafael / Marissa,

Thanks again for the call earlier. To recap: we're in the middle of an active investigation into a suspicious access pattern affecting several patient-subscription tenants. Our internal forensics team needs an extended window to complete log correlation and root-cause analysis.

Current Redwood policy is 30 days for ephemeral debug/audit traces for our hosted tenants, but we need you to hold Crestfield's tenant traces for an additional 60 days while the investigation completes (estimated 6–8 weeks).

Can Redwood approve a temporary retention concession for Crestfield with the following constraints?
- Timebox: 60 days from today's date (we're open to a shorter term if you prefer)
- Access: exports to be delivered to our secure S3 bucket; only Crestfield security and an approved Redwood engineer may access the export
- Evidence: we will supply a signed request and incident ticket numbers; we also need confirmation of the export process and proof-of-delete once the window closes

Attached is a short incident summary for context (incident-summary.pdf). Please let us know what evidence Redwood requires to approve a customer-specific retention variance and what compensating controls you'd want in place.

Samantha Liu
Head of Security Operations
Crestfield Health

---
Attachment: incident-summary.pdf (pdf, 68KB)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@crestfield.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-06-30T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retention grace for Crestfield tenant logs

Samantha — thanks for the summary and the attachment. I reviewed the short brief and looped in Ben (Customer Success lead) and Kimberly (Security) to scope the ask.

High level: Redwood can consider a timeboxed retention concession for a live investigation, but we require a small set of deliverables and compensating controls before we can enable a tenant-level change:
1) Signed customer request and authorized PO or deal amendment (we'll need legal to review).
2) A clearly scoped timeframe (start/end dates) and an owner at Crestfield for export acceptance.
3) Commitment that exported artifacts will be received into an encrypted bucket controlled by Crestfield (we will only push/export; we don't host the exported copy).
4) Confirmation that Crestfield's legal/infosec will accept an audit log of the export, including the operator, timestamp, and hash of delivered files.

Ben — can your team prepare the retention-evidence checklist and outline the export flow? Kimberly — please advise whether Security is comfortable with a temporary concession and what additional steps you need (HSM-wrapped keys, limited RBAC, ephemeral service account, signed DPA addendum).

If we can get those items, I propose we aim for a shorter window initially (45 days) to limit risk; we can extend if Crestfield provides periodic evidence of progress.

Rafael Mendes
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

> On 2029-06-30T08:22:00Z Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@crestfield.com> wrote:
> > Thanks again for the call earlier... (incident-summary.pdf attached)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@crestfield.com>
Date: 2029-07-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retention grace for Crestfield tenant logs

Rafael / Samantha — putting a brief technical proposal on the table (happy to walk through live):

Proposed approach
- Window: 45 days timebox from approval (shorter than 60 to reduce exposure)
- Export mechanics: create a safe-export job that pulls the targeted tenant ephemeral logs and writes to an encrypted tarball. The tarball will be HMAC-signed and then uploaded to the Crestfield S3 endpoint via a pre-authorized upload token.
- Access controls: produce a limited-lifetime service account for the export, audit every operation (who, when, bytes transferred), and record SHA256 checksums for delivered bundles.
- Compensating controls: ephemeral RBAC, mandatory 2-person approval for export start, rotate keys post-export, and store the export hash in Redwood's immutable audit ledger for traceability.

Required artifacts from Redwood to crestfield
- retention-evidence-checklist.pdf (attaching) — contains SOC 2 control references, CAIQ pointers, and the export checklist
- forensic-exports-instructions.txt — operational steps and expected delivery metadata

If Crestfield agrees to the above and legal completes a brief DPA addendum, we can schedule the export job inside 48 hours.

Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: retention-evidence-checklist.pdf (pdf, 52KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-07-02T16:45:00Z
Subject: Approval: conditional 45-day retention concession for Crestfield

Folks — after reviewing Ben's technical plan and the incident summary, Security approves a conditional retention concession for Crestfield. Conditions below must be met before we make any tenant-level change: 
1) Signed DPA addendum (we'll use the attached template). Legal to route DocuSign to the Crestfield signatory on file.
2) Crestfield must provide the S3 endpoint details and a named recipient (email + IAM principal) for the upload.
3) Redwood export will be timeboxed to one export job only; any re-exports require a separate approval.
4) Export audit trail (operator, timestamps, SHA256 checksums) must be accepted by Crestfield and retained by Redwood for 365 days for post-incident verification.
5) Exported bundles must be encrypted at rest and delivered over TLS with HMAC verification.

Implementation notes:
- Ben: proceed with the safe-export workflow and deliver retention-evidence-checklist.pdf and forensic-exports-instructions.txt to Crestfield.
- Rafael: coordinate legal for the DPA addendum (see DocuSign link in related_links) and record the concession under deal_id DEAL-4981 so billing/legal teams are aware.
- Marissa: please open JIRA SEC-7342 to track artifacts and closure criteria; attach a copy of the incident-summary and the export hash when complete.

I'll approve a 45-day window starting at the moment the export job begins; do not extend automatically. If Crestfield proves active progress with the investigation and requests an extension, escalate back to Security with evidence (interim reports every 14 days).

Kimberly Park
Head of Security Compliance
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: dpa-addendum-template.docx, forensic-exports-instructions.txt
